reviews.text: Thank you, Cody Cooley for providing excellent pool cleaning service!   You always keep our pool sparkling clean!   You have the best attitude and always make sure to let me know when you are on your way over.
reviews.author: andrea smith

reviews.text: Thank you Aiden for helping us complete our Pool inspection and water test results. Easy to understand and was able to get full report by the end of the day. I appreciate the professionalism and quickness Emerald Pool Care provided.
reviews.author: Austen Grimes

reviews.text:
I have been using EmeraldPool care for the past 18 months…  the technician is scheduled weekly for general cleaning and chemicals.  We discuss any changes that may need to be resolved and if necessary he will contact the office for follow up. It has been a pleasure to have Cody now as the primary technician for this route… he is timely and very respectful, he knows what needs to happen with the pool, I love the consistency!

In addition to Cody, Adan has been my go to for addressing the pool equipment.  He too is respectful and very professional as to what should be replaced  and what can wait.
The fact is the company is more interested in maintaining relationships than upselling when you don’t need it.
reviews.author: Denise J

reviews.text: We were traveling over Thanksgiving and I was having concerns about our pool while we were away. Jayda was extremely helpful in easing my mind and making sure that the pool was prepped for our absence. She explained everything thoroughly and had me feeling much better to leave for the week. Absolutely love the customer service and patience that we have received as being first time pool owners. Thank you!
reviews.author: Taren Heinrich

reviews.text: Cody does an excellent job maintaining our pool! He’s always on time, professional, and takes great care to make sure everything is running perfectly. It’s clear he takes pride in his work—our pool has never looked better. We really appreciate his consistency and attention to detail. Highly recommend Cody for anyone looking for reliable and top-quality pool service!
reviews.author: Tiffany Romo

reviews.text: Emerald built our pool, completing the work in June 2024. We signed up for Emerald’s weekly pool maintenance, paying the annual amount for that service. We were very pleased and re-enrolled for another year. They have changed the weekly service dates a couple of times (which they have every right to do under the terms of the service agreement) and it’s been fine as they’ve been really good about communicating in advance.  We are very pleased with the cleaning/maintenance efforts. Also great is the weekly report synopsis, with pictures, showing what all was done with that week’s cleaning.  William has been the most recent service technician and he’s done a super job. It’s clear that doing a good job is important to him and he doesn’t just rush to get through and on to his next appointment. If you’re looking for a pool cleaner, you should strongly consider what Emerald offers.
reviews.author: Walt Holmes

reviews.text: William does an excellent job caring for our pool.  He keeps the pool clean and sparkling, is always courteous and professional, and thoroughly answers any questions I have about the pool and maintenance.  He has been very accommodating about letting me know when he is on his way so I can make sure my dog is secured before he arrives.  I definitely recommend Emerald Pool Care and William to care for your pool maintenance and repairs!
reviews.author: Bonita Richardson

reviews.text: William has been taking excellent care of our pool. He’s always punctual, incredibly friendly, and consistently goes above and beyond to keep everything in great shape. We truly appreciate his outstanding service!
reviews.author: Joyce Goode

data.summary: The reviews are highly authentic in content, with specific details and varied customer experiences. The lack of any negative reviews or complaints is unusual but plausible for a small, highly-rated service business. The primary concern is the perfect 5.0 score with no critical feedback, which is statistically rare but not impossible for a business with only 32 reviews.
fake_signals: All Google reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
High concentration of reviews from the same recent time period (e.g., 'a month ago')
authentic_signals: Reviews mention specific employee names (Cody, Aiden, Adan, Jayda)
Reviews describe specific services (pool cleaning, inspection, equipment repair)
Reviews contain varied, personal writing styles and specific scenarios (travel over Thanksgiving, first-time pool owners)
data.discrepancy_explanation: No contradictory ratings found. Google shows perfect 5.0, BBB shows 'A' with no complaints. Yelp and other platforms have no reviews to compare.
